notes.title: Almost there
notes.content:
More bugs gone. 
The game will officially release soon. 
 
 
 Fixed an issue were some users experienced a very slow mouse camera control. 
 Fixed a round-off issue in time for score calculation. 
 Fixed HUD not matching resolution for the tutorial and when changing resolutions in a level. 
 Fixed controller navigation in the scoreboard windows.  
 Fixed a hole in the lava for the Volcano level. 
 Fixed saving right after ejecting out of a station loading a closed station. 
 Fixed an issue with the rotating bridges animation after a loaded save game. 
 Using the escape button will exit the credits shown after the breach level is completed. 
 Its no longer possible to trigger the enhancement while in the game menu. 
 Made a small change to the modular level.

notes.title: New level and more fixes
notes.content:
The latest update adds the extra level advanced quarry along witch a bunch of fixes.  

  
Complete list of mayor changes this update:  
  
 Added a new extra level: Advanced Quarry.  
 Added an extra input field at mouse sensitivity for users experiencing extreme slow camera controls. So they can enter higher sensitivity values then the slider provides.  
 Fixed lava station being unplugged in green mode in certain cases.  
 Fixed certain cases of stations being closed after loading the game.  
 Fixed enhancement station mesh issues in the factory level.  
 Fixed some display issues when using the controller for navigating the preferences menu.  
 Fixed any ball being able to go trough shields after changing to the energetic ball first.  
 Fixed inactive extractors on load game if a uncontrolled ball clone is in it.
 Fixed the extractor not disabling when a split clone dies in it.  
 Changed: Keycards displayed on the HUD now also scale with icon size preference.  
 Changed: Green ball can now also activate the weight scale after assimilating a lava ball.

notes.title: Green mode and translations
notes.content:
What is green mode?
In this mode, the player can bring up the enhancement menu by clicking the middle mouse button and install unlocked enhancements at will.
The ball will also receive new ball properties, by assimilating other balls.
For instance, assimilating a wooden ball makes you faster, and an ice ball makes you float.
Green mode unlocks after completing the final stage of the modular level.

Additional languages:
The game now supports French, German and Russian languages.
These translations are done with Google translate. I have some knowledge about French and German, but Russian is a complete gamble :-)
I will rely on the community to help me improve the translations.
See the translations forum section if you like to help.
The next step is store page translations.

The future
The game will move out of early access soon now.
There will be additional bug fixes and some extra levels.


Complete list of mayor changes this update:

German language support in game.
 French language support in game.
 Russian language support in game.
Added new game mode: Green mode.
Improved rankings display on website.
 Fixed issues with rankings website using Google chrome.
 Fixed an issue where a slow moving magnetic ball had trouble moving over a magnetic surface.
 Fixed exit not immediately moving down on trigger in the factory level.
 Fixed some speed issues when using cloak or boost in water.
[/list
]
Additional update:

 Improved the tutorial level its tutorial text display to support the new languages.
 Fixed some typo's.

notes.title: Update4: Linux version, savegame support and increased ball speeds.
notes.content:
Testing  the new ball speeds, and testing and bugfixing the save game feature took alot longer as anticipated.

Save Game details:
- The player can save 1 game.
- A save automaticly overwrites the old one.
- Saves are stored to the steam cloud.
- Saving more then 3 times in a level will have a slight score penalty.

New ball speed detail:
- The balls have a much higher top speed (twice as fast)
- Tweaked ball mass and accelerations.

Complete list of mayor changes this update:
- The game can now be played on Linux (Tested Ubuntu 14.04.1 LTS)
- Added save and load support for 1 save game.
- Added some more missing achivement art.
- Doubled ball types their maximum top speeds.
- Tweaked ball accelerations.
- Updated game engine to latest version. (Unity 4.6.1)
- Changed score calculations. It should be possible to break the current highscores.
- Cloack no longer works when a ball is in any water.
- Fixed game not running in offline mode.
- Fixed ball being force-pushed (stations exits) adding up while pausing the game, resulting in a super boost.
- Fixed splitting ball disapearing and game getting stuck when you died a couple of times with a splitted bal. 
- Fixed split ball issue: Ball must be grounded to split the ball.
- Platforms: Made some changes around the exit area.
- Swamp: Improved many wooden structures collisions for smoother ball movements.
- Swamp: A few other small changes and additions

notes.title: Full Controller support
notes.content:
It has been more work then anticipated to convert all the game menu's for controller support. But the game can now be played without the need of a keyboard/mouse, enabling full Big Picture support.
(Steam requires a restart go get rid of the "Requires a mouse and keyboard" message in big picture mode.)

It is possible this update changes a few quality settings, the texture and vsync settings to be specific.

Deleted scores
There was an issue where scores were submitted using the proceed button,
causing some invalid scores for the modular level played in stages.
Scores for this level have been wiped.

Full change list for this update:

 Added Full controller support.
 Added a Respawn menu option to the ingame menu. (Respawning has a time penalty)
 Added sound when clicking on a menu button with the mouse.
 Fixed first launch settings save button displayed on top of the advanced options.
 Fixed issues rebinding the mouse buttons.
 Fixed the Top Scores window not showing up and showing the message meant for the modular level that unlocks in stages.
  (Scores were still submited to the database.)
 This also fixes the King achievement not unlocking when you have a top score on the leaderboards.
 Fixed modular level still submitting scores while not in its final stage.
 Fixed Factory level its robots behavior. 
 Tonemapping tweaks (HDR)

notes.title: Game update : controller support.
notes.content:
The game now supports (xbox360) controllers.
Its no full support yet: the settings menu still needs a mouse/keyboard but the goal is to have full controller / big picture support.

More info about the xbox 360 controller keybinds can be found in this  forum thread .

Full patch notes:

 Added (partial) controller support.
 Added a bit of motion blur based on ball speed.
 Added a hide HUD keybind  (F11).
 Added a azerty configuration button under the control settings.
 Improved the greyscale achievements icons.
 Fixed water drag not working.
 Fixed the tree standing in the spawnplatform on Maze.
 Fixed ball horizontal center allignment being a tad off on screen.
 Fixed the selected level not centering properly in the load level window.
